Cost: 1,500eb (Very Expensive) ♦ Install: Clinic

Humanity Loss: 11 (3d6)

A Kiroshi implant designed for corporate photographers, with a vast swath of iterations. The most recent is the 4553, which features greater customization and faster software.

Cybereye (w/ Kiroshi Premier Cybereye Enhancement). Has 2 Option Slots for Cybereye Options. Comes pre-installed with MicroOptics, Opti-Zoom, and TeleOptics, none of which cause additional Humanity Loss or take up any Option Slots. None of the pre-installed options can be removed without destroying the Cybereye beyond repair.

NOTE: This is mostly based on a Computer Terminal in Cyberpunk 2077.

Type: Cybereye (Foundational)
Install: Clinic
Option Slots: uses 0, provides 2

Foundry notes:

  • The pre-installed MicroOptics, Opti-Zoom, and TeleOptics are described here rather than installed as separate items.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Cyberware > Cyberoptics).
